schools_proximity.moe_primary_registration_rule: Under the Ministry of Education (MOE) Primary 1 Registration Framework, home-school distance is officially calculated as the shortest straight-line distance from the specific residential block/tower to the school reference point via Singapore Land Authority (SLA) OneMap SchoolQuery. Priority tiers are: (1) Within 1km, (2) 1km to 2km, and (3) Outside 2km.

within_1km.name: Anderson Primary School
within_1km.status: The ONLY primary school strictly within the 1km radius of Lentor Modern.
within_1km.official_verification: SLA OneMap SchoolQuery & MOE SchoolFinder verified.

within_1km_to_2km.name: CHIJ St. Nicholas Girls' School (Primary)
within_1km_to_2km.status: Strictly in the 1km to 2km band. NOT within 1km.
within_1km_to_2km.notes: Lentor Modern residents qualify under the 1km - 2km priority band (Phase 2C / Phase 2B). It is not within 1km despite marketing claims on generic property websites.
within_1km_to_2km.official_verification: SLA OneMap SchoolQuery & MOE SchoolFinder verified.
